rationale: The discourse has stabilized around the same unresolved fault line: labour and the state insist on no closures/no compulsory redundancies, while management, the family holding, and investors still keep closures and deeper footprint reductions on the table. The expert has clarified that a closure-free path is possible but not proven sufficient, so the parties are circling the same quantified trade-off without resolving it; a structured intervention with hard numbers is now needed rather than more principle exchanges.
